lead: A hand-painted oil painting on canvas, thick palette-knife strokes and impasto, rich natural colour, epic cinematic scale, dramatic natural light, not a photograph, not a 3D render.
style: Painted full-bleed to all four edges of a 16:9 canvas, no text, no lettering, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border, no UI

frames.prompt: A colossal mountain filling the whole sky, its summit lost in clouds, seen from far away. At the very bottom a calm lush tropical foothill with palm trees and a turquoise lagoon in warm golden morning light, and a tiny climber in dark outdoor gear with a bright red scarf and a backpack standing as a barely visible speck at the base. Up the mountain the face changes in bands: green jungle, then red arid desert cliffs, then dark rocky cliffs under storm clouds, then white icy snowfields under the summit.

Close view of an arid desert face of the mountain, sunburnt red and ochre sandstone cliffs, hot hazy sun, dry scrub, a tiny climber in dark outdoor gear with a bright red scarf and a backpack small on the rock climbing with bare hands and a rope, a long shadow, a vast drop below with the tropical green far away in the haze.

A dark rocky cliff face of the mountain in a violent tempest, heavy rain streaming down black wet rock, lightning in dark storm clouds, a tiny climber in dark outdoor gear with a bright red scarf and a backpack tiny and clinging to the rock with one hand, rope and pitons, rain lashing sideways, dramatic and dangerous.

A steep white icy face of the mountain in a blizzard, wind-driven snow, blue glacial ice and frost, a tiny climber in dark outdoor gear with a bright red scarf and a backpack tiny on the ice wall using ice axes and crampons, ropes, a storm swirling, cold blue-grey light.

The climber slips on the steep icy face and falls, hanging from his rope by one hand still gripping the ice, the rope taut, snow flying, a long drop below, a tiny climber in dark outdoor gear with a bright red scarf and a backpack, dramatic moment, storm light.

The summit above the storm at sunrise: a tiny climber in dark outdoor gear with a bright red scarf and a backpack planting a red flag on the peak, an endless sea of golden clouds below, the dark tempest far beneath, warm radiant sun, an unbelievably beautiful peaceful landscape of clouds and distant peaks.
